name: commit
description: Delegate git commit and push to a subagent on the host's cheapest model, keeping routine version-control work off the main session model.
shortDescription: Delegate commit and push to a cheap subagent.
longDescription: Commit provides a single skill that, when the user asks to commit or push, has the main model delegate the whole stage-and-commit flow to a subagent running on the host's cheapest available model. The main model only issues one delegation call and relays the result; the subagent stages related changes, checks for staged secrets, writes a message in the repository's existing style following the host's standard commit conventions, and pushes only on explicit request.
